scientific_sources.source_title: Academy of Nutrition and Dietetics — Nutrition Assessment
scientific_sources.locator: Nutrition Assessment / Nutrition Assessment Critical Thinking
bounded_source_support: Nutrition Assessment is the first Nutrition Care Process step and its collected data support later NCP steps.
Assessment uses multiple domains, including food/nutrition history, anthropometrics, biochemical/tests, physical findings and client history.
Critical thinking includes identifying needs for additional information and obtaining/requesting relevant data.

scientific_sources.source_title: 2025 AHA/ACC Multisociety High Blood Pressure Guideline — current corrected online version
scientific_sources.locator: current online guideline: BP classification + treatment threshold/risk sections
bounded_source_support: Current corrected guideline classifies stage 1 hypertension as systolic 130–139 or diastolic 80–89 mmHg.
Management recommendations use average BP and cardiovascular/clinical-risk context rather than a single isolated reading.

scientific_sources.source_title: American Heart Association — Home Blood Pressure Monitoring
scientific_sources.locator: Who should monitor / measurement instructions / high reading / journal sections
bounded_source_support: Repeated measurements and correct technique are part of BP interpretation.
Home monitoring can aid confirmation, while a medical professional confirms diagnosis.
A single high reading should not be treated as a complete longitudinal BP picture.

scientific_sources.source_title: USPSTF — Healthy Diet and Physical Activity Counseling in Adults With CVD Risk Factors
scientific_sources.locator: Final Recommendation Statement / Recommendation Summary / Clinician Summary
bounded_source_support: The recommendation applies to adults with cardiovascular disease risk factors and recommends offering or referring them for behavioral counseling.
Applicability requires risk-factor context; the topic is under update at the cutoff.
The 2025–2030 Dietary Guidelines provide general nutrition guidance to meet nutrient needs, promote health and prevent disease.
This is broad population guidance rather than a case-specific individualized assessment protocol.

scientific_sources.source_title: USPSTF — Behavioral Weight Loss Interventions in Adults
bounded_source_support: USPSTF recommends intensive multicomponent behavioral interventions for adults with BMI 30 or higher.
The topic is under update at the cutoff.
